newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber narrowly mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber narrowly mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were narrowly mixed in after-hours trade on Monday as the market paused after gaining sharply during the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.6 yen per kg lower to 0.1 yen up from the day's close. Benchmark April was flat at 144.7 yen.

During the day, the spot November contract expired at noon at 136.8 yen, up 4.2 yen from last Friday. The higher expiry price and the yen's weakness spurred short-covering and bargain-hunting buying, traders said.
"Prices could post a modest rebound in improved sentiment," one trader said. -- Tokyo Commodities Desk +81-3-3432-7431
